name: Match cut
summary: A cut between two shots whose main forms have the same shape, position or movement, so that the eye carries one form across the cut.
how: Match the shape, the position and the scale of the main form across the cut within 10% of the frame width.
In an interface, move the shared element from its old box to its new box in 250 to 350ms while the rest of the screen fades.

origin.note: Graphic matches are older; the reference case is Stanley Kubrick's cut from a thrown bone to a satellite in orbit.

adoptions.via: Material motion in Android 5.0 carries one element from screen to screen as a shared-element transition.

sources.title: David Bordwell and Kristin Thompson, Film Art: An Introduction (McGraw-Hill)
